anchor: We support ending unilateral economic sanctions.
paraphrase: Our delegation favors removing one-sided financial restrictions.
opposite: We oppose ending unilateral economic sanctions.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. Our delegation supports improving access to primary education.

anchor: We call for an immediate ceasefire to protect civilians.
paraphrase: Hostilities must stop now so that noncombatants are safe.
opposite: We reject an immediate ceasefire to protect civilians.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. We call for wider access to affordable clean energy.

anchor: We support independent inspections of nuclear facilities.
paraphrase: Our delegation endorses impartial monitoring of atomic sites.
opposite: We do not support independent inspections of nuclear facilities.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. We support the right to inclusive social protection.

anchor: We urge wealthy countries to fund climate adaptation in vulnerable states.
paraphrase: Rich nations should finance resilience to global warming in exposed countries.
opposite: We oppose wealthy countries funding climate adaptation in vulnerable states.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. We urge all delegations to respect human rights.

anchor: We support the right of peoples to self-determination.
paraphrase: Communities should be free to choose their own political status.
opposite: We reject the right of peoples to self-determination.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. We support strengthening technical assistance for customs services.

anchor: Artificial intelligence must remain under meaningful human control.
paraphrase: People should retain real oversight of automated intelligent systems.
opposite: Artificial intelligence should operate without meaningful human control.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. Our delegation calls for protection of the marine environment.

anchor: Humanitarian assistance must reach civilians without obstruction.
paraphrase: Relief supplies need unhindered access to people affected by conflict.
opposite: Humanitarian assistance should not reach civilians without obstruction.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. Our delegation favors financing sustainable development.

anchor: We condemn racial discrimination and support equal rights.
paraphrase: Our delegation rejects unequal treatment based on race and favors equality.
opposite: We do not condemn racial discrimination or support equal rights.
boilerplate: Thank you, Chair. We condemn attacks on critical infrastructure.
